# Question Three
The prime factors of $13195$ are $5, 7, 13$ and $29$
What is the largest prime factor of the number $600851475143$?

Prime factorization is one of the great modern questions of math and computer science. One relatively quick way of finding prime factors for a number is called the [Sieve Of Ersatosthenes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sieve_of_Eratosthenes)

Implementing the Sieve is a kind of a dynamic programming solution, we need to list a lot of numbers and eliminate them as we go.

This time I am going to benchmark python loops against cpp loops against r loops. I am going to use a few tricks, like only doing odd numbers
